rungs.title: Administrative Officer (AO)
rungs.summary: Carries out routine tasks and handles enquiries or cases by following guidance.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the rules and procedures for the work in front of them and where to find the answer when they do not.
rungs.delivery: Completes routine work accurately and on time with regular checks from a manager.
rungs.leadership: Works well with the immediate team and treats customers fairly and politely.

rungs.title: Executive Officer (EO)
rungs.summary: Runs a caseload or a small area of work with some independence, and may supervise a few people.
rungs.knowledge: Understands why the rules exist, not only what they say, and applies them to less routine cases.
rungs.delivery: Plans their own work, spots problems early and escalates what they cannot settle.
rungs.leadership: Supervises or guides colleagues and communicates clearly in writing and in person.

rungs.title: Higher Executive Officer (HEO)
rungs.summary: Manages a team or leads a specialist area, and contributes to plans and advice.
rungs.knowledge: Has depth in one area and a working view of how it fits the wider department.
rungs.delivery: Delivers a work package or team objectives, manages risks and reports progress with evidence.
rungs.leadership: Manages people day to day, handles performance and coaches others to improve.

rungs.title: Senior Executive Officer (SEO)
rungs.summary: Leads a larger team or a significant piece of work and advises more senior colleagues.
rungs.knowledge: Recognised as the person others come to for advice in their area, with a sound grasp of policy and delivery.
rungs.delivery: Owns outcomes and budgets for a defined area and balances quality, cost and time.
rungs.leadership: Leads managers and teams through change and builds relationships across the department.

rungs.title: Grade 7
rungs.summary: Leads a policy, delivery or operational area, manages managers and prepares advice for senior leaders.
rungs.knowledge: Combines deep subject knowledge with a wide view of the department, government priorities and public money.
rungs.delivery: Is accountable for a programme, service or policy area, including its budget, risks and results.
rungs.leadership: Leads teams of managers, influences senior stakeholders and speaks credibly for their area.

rungs.title: Grade 6
rungs.summary: Leads a large area of work and its senior managers, and advises directors and ministers' offices.
rungs.knowledge: Is a recognised authority on their area and understands the political, financial and legal setting it sits in.
rungs.delivery: Delivers significant outcomes across several teams, owning the plan, the money and the risks end to end.
rungs.leadership: Leads leaders, shapes direction with senior colleagues and represents the department outside it.
